company.name: Elphinstone
company.shortDescription: Elphinstone is an investment robo-advisory platform for the community.
company.description: Elphinstone serves as the community's investment robo-advisory platform. They provide investment services and products that are handled by companies that are likewise licensed asset management firms that have been registered and are subject to SECP regulation. They assist clients in purchasing community mutual funds with a track record of long-term success, run by some of the area's respected asset management firms.
